newsitem.title: CANADA: Ensign to acquire U.S. drilling rigs.
newsitem.headline: Ensign to acquire U.S. drilling rigs.

text.p: Ensign Resource Service Group Inc said on Wednesday that its U.S. drilling unit, Caza Drilling (1994) Inc, agreed to buy all of the U.S. drilling assets owned by Lynx Energy Services Corp for an undisclosed sum.
Ensign said the assets, operated by Lynx unit Cardinal Drilling Co, include 14 operational oil and gas rigs and related assets based in the Rocky Mountain states.
The purchaase is to be funded from working capital, Ensign said.
After the close of the deal, Caza will operate 46 rigs in the U.S. Rocky Mountain region, it said.
